propositions: Live focused prerequisite responses include top-level runner metadata fields (runner, model, trace_id, _usage) alongside records, but strict validation rejects the entire response as malformed.
The normalization pipeline converts all expected records to indeterminate/output-invalid when runner metadata is present, causing recall and validity to drop to 0.0 despite valid record content.

Focused prerequisite finder must accept and normalize only the records payload while preserving rejection of malformed, missing, duplicate, unknown, or cross-attributed records within the payload itself.
Production-shaped responses with standard runner envelope metadata should yield valid finding/consistent records rather than failing validation.
